audit_findings.detail: All four new modules are contract-first (types + signatures + Zod schemas). getKnowledgeState returns empty Map (stub), getOuterFringe returns [] (stub), SrsToKstBridge is interface-only with no concrete buildLearnerState. No algorithmic behavior (hysteresis, decay, fringe membership) leaked into Phase 1.

KnowledgeStateEntry (v2 per-node entry: nodeId, mastery, retention, isProficient, state) is structurally distinct from KnowledgeState (flat-list projection: { skills: { nodeId, mastery }[] }). Compile-time guard at knowledge-state-engine-signature.test.ts:58-61 uses conditional type assertion to confirm non-assignability. projectDisplayLevel callers are unaffected.

Object.freeze applied. Values match strategy exactly (masteryEnter 0.9, masteryExit 0.7, readyThreshold 0.8, nearThreshold 0.5). JS strict equality 0.9 === 0.90. Object.isFrozen asserted by test. masteryThresholdsSchema uses z.strictObject to reject extra keys.

getOuterFringe accepts optional readinessFn: (nodeId, state) => number. Track 2 can swap weighted-readiness implementation without contract change. Seam exercised by outer-fringe-signature.test.ts:27-37.

ObjectiveProficiencyResult is re-declared structurally (not imported from srs-engine) to keep core dependency-free. Drift risk is documented in code comments and test-strategy §1.4 risk #3. Phase 3 round-trip test is the mitigation. Acceptable for Phase 1 contract-first scope.

knowledge-space.md contains canonical pointer to kst-srs.v2/SPECIFICATION.md (line 5). No 'source of truth' claim remains. index.md has Knowledge Space Contract row (line 16). Current Measure Tracks footer updated (line 117). All asserted by docs-reconciliation.test.ts (3 tests).

All 'exit 0' claims in plan.md match actual gate runs. 332/332 test counts confirmed. 30 new tests across 6 files confirmed (13+5+4+4+1+3). UMV task [b] deferred:user correctly not claimed as verified.

Every test has positive AND negative assertions. Schema tests: parse valid AND reject invalid (out-of-range, partial, extra-key, unknown state, missing nodeId). Export tests: exists AND is function. No vacuous 'marker consistent' or 'module loaded' checks.
Threshold values asserted via labeled toEqual({masteryEnter: 0.9, ...}) deep-equal. No bare-digit regex matching.
automation-supervisor.py was not modified in Phase 1 commits. AGENTS.md peer-reviewed component rule intact.

conclusion: Phase 1 is contract-first and clean. All four new modules export types/schemas/signatures with no algorithmic behavior. KnowledgeStateEntry is compile-time distinct from projection KnowledgeState. Thresholds are frozen with correct values. readinessFn seam enables Track 2 swap. Docs reconciliation is truthful. All gate commands exit 0. No blockers found.
